import os, re, itertools
from openpyxl import load_workbook

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/325-44/1_325-44_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/325-44_1_4b4f8739/1_325-44_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws_in = wb["Input"]
ws_out = wb["Output"] if "Output" in wb.sheetnames else wb.create_sheet("Output")

def convert_token(tok):
    if tok is None:
        return None
    s = str(tok).strip()
    if len(s) >= 2 and ((s[0] == s[-1] == '"') or (s[0] == s[-1] == "'")):
        s = s[1:-1]
    s = s.strip()
    # Convert numeric-looking values to numbers, preserving text identifiers like orgId/careType as text
    if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d+", s):
        return int(s)
    if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d+\.\d+", s):
        return float(s)
    return s

def parse_filter(filter_text):
    result = {}
    if filter_text is None:
        return result
    text = str(filter_text).strip().rstrip(";")
    
    # Match parenthesized conditions: ("field" = "value") or ("field" IN LIST a,b,c)
    for m in re.finditer(r'\(\s*"([^"]+)"\s*(=|IN\s+LIST)\s*(.*?)\s*\)', text, flags=re.I):
        field = m.group(1)
        op = m.group(2).upper()
        raw = m.group(3).strip()
        if op == "=":
            result[field] = [convert_token(raw)]
        else:
            parts = [p.strip() for p in raw.split(",") if p.strip() != ""]
            result[field] = [convert_token(p) for p in parts]
    return result

# Read headers from Input
input_headers = {}
for c in range(1, ws_in.max_column + 1):
    val = ws_in.cell(1, c).value
    if val is not None:
        input_headers[str(val)] = c

required_base = ["wtype_id", "name", "status"]
filter_col = input_headers.get("filter")

output_rows = []
for r in range(2, ws_in.max_row + 1):
    if all(ws_in.cell(r, input_headers[h]).value is None for h in required_base if h in input_headers) and (filter_col is None or ws_in.cell(r, filter_col).value is None):
        continue
    
    base = {
        "wtype_id": ws_in.cell(r, input_headers["wtype_id"]).value,
        "name": ws_in.cell(r, input_headers["name"]).value,
        "status": ws_in.cell(r, input_headers["status"]).value,
    }
    parsed = parse_filter(ws_in.cell(r, filter_col).value if filter_col else None)
    
    org_vals = parsed.get("orgId", [None])
    care_vals = parsed.get("careType", [None])
    spec_vals = parsed.get("specialtyId", [None])
    context_vals = parsed.get("contextId", [None])
    
    for org, care, spec, ctx in itertools.product(org_vals, care_vals, spec_vals, context_vals):
        output_rows.append([base["wtype_id"], base["name"], base["status"], org, care, spec, ctx])

# Modify only Output!A1:G10
for row in ws_out.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=10, min_col=1, max_col=7):
    for cell in row:
        cell.value = None

headers = ["wtype_id", "name", "status", "orgId", "careType", "specialtyId", "contextId"]
for c, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
    ws_out.cell(1, c).value = h

for idx, row_values in enumerate(output_rows[:9], start=2):
    for c, value in enumerate(row_values, 1):
        ws_out.cell(idx, c).value = value

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
